messages.text: The expanded differential verifier now passes all 19 cases, covering help/version, Clap failures, source-ordered domain validation, all three search strategies, AES, ZipCrypto, and encrypted-entry fallback. The remaining acceptance gate is packaging: `compile.sh` must remove every higher-priority stale entrypoint and produce a directly runnable Windows command, after which I’ll run the original Rust tests, the generated entrypoint end to end, and a final prompt-to-artifact audit with file/line evidence.
